LAZYMUSIC.Settings.YouTubeApiKeyHint: API key from Google Cloud Console with YouTube Data API v3 enabled.
LAZYMUSIC.Settings.SyncToPlayersHint: Broadcast GM playback to all connected players.
LAZYMUSIC.Settings.ServerUrlHint: Usually NOT needed: the module's built-in helper is used automatically (launch Foundry via the "Foundry VTT (with music)" shortcut). Set this only as a fallback — the "My Music" server address as players see it (e.g. http://26.x.x.x:8765 over Radmin).
LAZYMUSIC.NeedApiKey: Set your YouTube API key in module settings
LAZYMUSIC.ChoosePlaylist: Pick a playlist or search for tracks
LAZYMUSIC.ClearCacheTooltip: Clear downloaded music cache on disk
LAZYMUSIC.UpdateConfirm: Installed yt-dlp is {version}, released {days} days ago. Update? About 18 MB will be downloaded; playback will not stop.
LAZYMUSIC.Updating: Lazy Music: updating yt-dlp, this may take up to a minute...
LAZYMUSIC.Updated: Lazy Music: yt-dlp updated, {was} → {now}. Downloads work again.
LAZYMUSIC.UpdateNotNeeded: Lazy Music: yt-dlp is already up to date ({version}). If downloads still fail, the cause is elsewhere — see server/helper.log.
LAZYMUSIC.UpdateError: Lazy Music: could not update yt-dlp — {error}
LAZYMUSIC.HelperDownUpdate: Lazy Music: the helper is not running, so nothing can be updated. Launch Foundry via the "Foundry VTT (with music)" shortcut.
LAZYMUSIC.CacheEmpty: Lazy Music: cache is already empty.
LAZYMUSIC.CacheConfirm: Delete downloaded music from disk? The cache holds {files} files ({mb} MB). Tracks will re-download next time they are played.
LAZYMUSIC.CacheError: Lazy Music: failed to clear cache — {error}
LAZYMUSIC.HelperDownCache: Lazy Music: the helper is not running — nothing to clear the cache with. Launch Foundry via the "Foundry VTT (with music)" shortcut.
LAZYMUSIC.InCache: Downloaded — plays from the cache folder, no helper needed
LAZYMUSIC.CacheFailed: Lazy Music: could not download the track ({error}). Playing via YouTube.
LAZYMUSIC.CacheHint: The helper is not running: only downloaded tracks (gold dot) will play. To download the rest, launch Foundry via the "Foundry VTT (with music)" shortcut — or drop files named <video ID>.m4a straight into Data/modules/lazy-music/cache.
LAZYMUSIC.HelperFallback: Lazy Music: the helper is not running and this track is not cached — playing via YouTube directly (players on VPN may hit error 150). Launch Foundry via the "Foundry VTT (with music)" shortcut.
LAZYMUSIC.AllTracksBlocked: ⛔ All tracks in this playlist are unavailable. YouTube blocks embedding. Try another playlist.
LAZYMUSIC.CacheOpened: Lazy Music: downloaded tracks folder opened.
LAZYMUSIC.HelperDownOpen: Lazy Music: the helper is not running, so the folder could not be opened. Launch Foundry via the "Foundry VTT (with music)" shortcut.
LAZYMUSIC.Settings.PhoneAddressHint: Set in the “Pull from phone” dialog.
LAZYMUSIC.Settings.PhoneTokenHint: Set in the “Pull from phone” dialog.
LAZYMUSIC.PhoneHint: On the phone, turn on “Share library with computer” and copy both lines here. The app must be open.
LAZYMUSIC.PhoneUnreachable: No answer from {address}. Is the app open and both on the same network?
LAZYMUSIC.PhoneBadToken: Wrong code. It is shown in the app settings next to the address.
LAZYMUSIC.PhoneStrangeAnswer: Something other than Lazy Music answers at that address.
LAZYMUSIC.PhoneTooNew: The phone app is newer than the module — update the module.
LAZYMUSIC.PhoneSearchAsk: Look for the phone on the network?
LAZYMUSIC.PhoneSearchWhy: The router may have given the phone a new address. I will try the neighbours — a few seconds.
LAZYMUSIC.PhoneNotFound: No phone found on this network. Check the address in the app settings.
LAZYMUSIC.PhoneNothingNew: Everything from the phone is already here.
LAZYMUSIC.PhoneUntouched: Lists not on the phone, left alone: {n}
